caveat: dHash is only candidate retrieval, not proof of identity or independence. Crops, rotations and session-related photos may be missed.

label_semantics_review.old: Relatively loose boxes around visible dark object; full-body/head extent cannot be reliably resolved in blurry examples.
label_semantics_review.external: Clear examples use tight boxes around head/dark anterior region, excluding the translucent tail.
label_semantics_review.recommendation: Decide on one target definition. For counting, one reviewed head box per visible identifiable shrimp is an option, but old labels must be audited for consistency before mixing. Do not expand boxes mechanically.

dedup_review.nearest_visual_result: No same-scene duplicate confirmed among the 6 inspected pairs.
dedup_review.dhash_candidates: Rejected as unreliable on pale low-texture images; do not remove these automatically.
dedup_review.limitations: Does not rule out crops, rotations, or same-session images. Source/session provenance unavailable.
